description.value: Jimoco Café & Pasta is an Italian-Korean fusion restaurant in Port Coquitlam, serving handmade pastas, risottos, and fresh seafood dishes alongside Korean-influenced plates like a braised pork belly rice bowl. The menu spans Italian classics such as spaghetti carbonara and chicken marsala as well as creative fusions, all prepared in a warm, cozy dining room. A catering menu of pasta and salad trays is also available for events.

address.value: 2840 Oxford St #2, Port Coquitlam, BC V3B 5L7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pocojimoco.com is clearly for a Port Coquitlam restaurant ('2840 Oxford St #2, Port Coquitlam, BC V3B 5L7'), not North Vancouver as the OSM community tag and coordinates suggest — the domain prefix 'poco' itself stands for Port Coquitlam. The website confirms pickup/delivery ordering (takeout) and shows some clearly vegetarian pasta dishes (e.g. Penne Verde). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM coordinates and community tag ('North Vancouver') do not match the business address on the website (Port Coquitlam, BC V3B 5L7) — OSM node appears to be geographically misplaced by several kilometres.
